solutions.title: DFS colors
solutions.strategy: Build precedence edges and use color-marked DFS to detect cycles and produce postorder.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character and edge is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The graph, color map, and output stack are stored.

solutions.title: Kahn topological sort
solutions.strategy: Track indegrees and repeatedly remove the lowest available zero-indegree character.

timeComplexity.explanation: Priority-queue operations keep deterministic output among zero-indegree characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The graph, indegrees, and heap store characters and edges.
